name: Banana Oatmeal
ingredients: 1 cup plant-based milk of your choice
Toppings of your choice (such as nuts, seeds, or maple syrup)
instructions: In a saucepan, mash the ripe banana with a fork.
Add the rolled oats, plant-based milk, and cinnamon to the saucepan. Stir well to combine.
Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the oats are cooked and the mixture has thickened (about 5-7 minutes).
Once the oatmeal is ready, remove from heat and transfer to a bowl.
Top with your favorite toppings, such as nuts, seeds, or a drizzle of maple syrup. Enjoy your quick and delicious banana oatmeal!
